business_problem: reduce the manual, repetitive work of building and maintaining data pipelines so smaller teams can deliver analytics faster and at lower cost.
solution_summary: Matillion uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence, and Cortex Search on Snowflake to reduce the manual, repetitive work of building and maintaining data pipelines so smaller teams can deliver analytics faster and at lower cost. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so data engineers, analysts, and business users can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Snowflake Intelligence broadens self-service analytics with natural-language access to governed metrics and datasets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Matillion achieved ~40% lower infrastructure costs and 50% reduction in analyst workload.
